name: Naunihal Scholarship Yojana
benefit:
The "Scholarship" amount mentioned against each class and course will be payable in lump sum annually.

_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant should be resident of Chhattisgarh. 
1. Only two children from a same will get the benefits.
1. There is no requirement for a specific grade to obtain the scholarship
1. There will be no requirement of marks to avail the benefits of the scheme.
1. After admission in college/polytechnic or other course for engineering or medical education, the students receiving scholarship amount under this scheme will be required to study for minimum 1 year in that course. In case of first year dropout, the scholarship amount will have to be returned.
1. The beneficiary should have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the period of one year before the date of application.
